# BytePortal

> BytePortal (https://www.byteportal.tech/) is a technical publication delivering honest AI tool reviews, head-to-head comparisons, and practical developer tutorials to boost productivity and simplify workflows.

## Key Information
- Domain: https://www.byteportal.tech/
- Focus: Practical AI tools, LLM benchmarks, cloud emulators, coding agents, productivity workflows.
- Standards: Hands-on tested, factual, fluff-free, zero sponsored bias.

## Core Articles
- [PhotoCraft: Free Open-Source Photoshop Alternative in Rust](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/photocraft/): In-depth review of PhotoCraft from the ArtCraft suite, analyzing its native WGPU compute shader rendering, PSD file parsing, under 180MB memory footprint, Model Context Protocol (MCP) agent endpoints, and how it compares to Photoshop, GIMP, and Photopea.
- [Spline AI: Build Interactive 3D Web Scenes from Text Prompts](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/spline-ai/): Hands-on guide to Spline AI, covering text-to-3D generation, image-to-3D, AI textures, visual event-based physics, direct React and WebGL code export, and real-world payload trade-offs.
- [Cursor vs Windsurf: Which AI Code Editor Wins in 2026?](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/cursor-vs-windsurf/): In-depth comparison of Cursor and Windsurf on real codebases, analyzing Composer shadow diffs vs Cascade real-time terminal flows, context retrieval precision, fast request limits, and when to pick each editor.
- [OpenCode: Free Open-Source Coding Agent for Your Terminal](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/opencode/): Complete guide to OpenCode v2, an MIT-licensed coding agent from Anomaly that runs on your local machine, hooks into your shell or desktop, connects to 200+ models or local Ollama, and provides multi-session tabs, diffs, and snapshot undo.
- [Coolify vs Dokploy: Which Self-Hosted PaaS Wins in 2026?](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/coolify-vs-dokploy/): Head-to-head comparison of Coolify v4 and Dokploy on a $5 VPS, analyzing idle RAM consumption, Laravel vs TypeScript architectures, Traefik and Caddy reverse proxies, multi-server clustering, and operational failure modes.
- [n8n Self-Hosted: AI Workflows Without the Zapier Bill](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/n8n-self-hosted/): Hands-off guide to self-hosting n8n with Docker for AI agent and automation workflows, covering execution-based pricing, the Sustainable Use License limits, the real ops cost, and where the free Community edition stops.
- [Dokploy: Self-Hosted PaaS for Docker Apps](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/dokploy/): Guide to Dokploy, a free open-source PaaS that installs on a VPS with Docker Swarm, Traefik, PostgreSQL, and Redis to deploy Git apps, Compose stacks, and databases with SSL and backups - plus the real cost of running your own control plane.
- [ArtCraft: 13+ Free Open-Source Adobe Alternatives in Pure Rust](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/artcraft-apps/): Overview of the 13+ native desktop applications in the ArtCraft suite replacing Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and Office with lightweight, GPU-accelerated Rust binaries and zero subscriptions.
- [Run AWS Locally on Your Laptop with AWS Emulator](https://www.byteportal.tech/blogs/aws-emulator/): Complete guide to running AWS services (S3, DynamoDB, SQS, Lambda) locally with AWS Emulator for zero cloud costs, rapid iteration, and fast coding agent feedback loops.

## Site Structure & Verification
- [About BytePortal](https://www.byteportal.tech/about/): Editorial mission, team, and testing methodology.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.byteportal.tech/privacy/): Data handling, cookies, and privacy compliance.

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.byteportal.tech/sitemap.xml): Full URL directory for web indexers.
